units.source_text: “决不可惜啊。不过，我不是那种女人。不是那种女人啊！”

en.t: "It isn't that I begrudge it at all. But I am not that kind of woman. I am not that kind of woman!"

units.source_text: 岛村想起这句话，踟蹰不前了。

en.t: Remembering those words, Shimamura hesitated and could not go forward.

units.source_text: 女子敏感地觉察到，条件反射似地站立起来。这时正好传来了汽笛声，她说了声“是零点的上行车”，

en.t: The woman sensed it sharply and sprang to her feet as if by reflex. Just then a whistle sounded, and she said, "That is the midnight up train,"

units.source_text: 然后猛一下拉开纸窗，然后推开玻璃窗，一屁股坐上窗台，身体倚在窗栏上。

en.t: Then she flung open the paper screen, pushed open the glass window, dropped herself onto the windowsill, and leaned her body against the window rail.
